```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
```

wga data
```{r}
wga <- data.table::fread("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/HDP_input_ImmuneCells.csv") %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::rename("MutationType"="Mutation type") %>%
  mutate(MutationType = paste0(substring(Trinucleotide,1,1), "[",
                               MutationType,
                               "]", substring(Trinucleotide,3,3))) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Trinucleotide)

# write.table(wga, file = "/mnt/storage/peter/repo/manuAA/data/wga_uc_bloodfraction.txt",
#             row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE, sep = "\t")

## Cleaned PBMC samples with WGA cell line data
# Rscript //mnt/storage/peter/repo/manuAA/code/wga_bloodfraction_sr_wga.R

load("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/SigRescueR/wga_bloodfraction_sr_wga.rda")
SigRescueR::SigRescueAnalyze(res = res)
# SigRescueR::SigRescuePlot(res = res, context = "96", 
#                           output_path = "/mnt/storage/peter/repo/manuAA/data/wga_bf_sr_wga/",
#                           filename = "wga_bf_sr_wga")

samp.cleaned <- samp.cleaned %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 0)))

write.table(samp.cleaned, file = "/mnt/storage/peter/repo/manuAA/data/wga_bf_sr_wga/wga_uc_bloodfraction.txt",
            row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE, sep = "\t")

## Run SPE
# python /mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/code/spe_wga_bloodfraction_uc_sbs.py

# load reference signatures
ref.sigs <- ICAMS::ReadCatalog("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/spe/wga_uc_bloodfraction_sbs/SBS96/Suggested_Solution/COSMIC_SBS96_Decomposed_Solution/Signatures/COSMIC_SBS96_Signatures.txt")
ref.sigs <- ICAMS::as.catalog(ref.sigs,
                              ref.genome = "GRCh38",
                              region = "genome",
                              catalog.type = "counts.signature")

prior.sigs <- colnames(ref.sigs)

input_file <- "/mnt/storage/peter/repo/manuAA/data/wga_bf_sr_wga/wga_uc_bloodfraction.txt"
input_catalog <- ICAMS::ReadCatalog(file = input_file)

## Signature attribution with mSigAct
sparseAssign <- SparseAssignActivity(spectra = input_catalog,
                                     sigs = ref.sigs[,prior.sigs],
                                     max.level = length(prior.sigs)-1,
                                     p.thresh = 0.05/length(prior.sigs),
                                     num.parallel.samples = 5,
                                     mc.cores.per.sample = 20,
                                     drop.low.mut.samples = FALSE,
                                     seed = 425,
                                     output.dir = "/mnt/storage/peter/repo/manuAA/data/mSigAct/wga_uc_cosmic_srWGA")

# save(sparseAssign, file = "/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/mSigAct/wga_uc_cosmic_srWGA.rda")
```

WGA results
```{r}
## WGS result from figure 1
load("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/mSigAct/wga_uc_cosmic_srWGA.rda")

mSigAct_pd <- sparseAssign$proposed.assignment %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  'rownames<-' (gsub(pattern = "PBMC::", replacement = "", x = rownames(.))) %>%
  'rownames<-' (gsub(pattern = "-cell", replacement = "", x = rownames(.))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("WGA", rownames(.))) %>%
  sweep(1, rowSums(.), "/") %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .))) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Samples") %>% 
  gather(data = ., key = "signatures", value = "value", -Samples) %>%
  mutate(group = paste0("UC", as.numeric(str_extract(Samples, "\\d+"))),
         type = gsub(pattern = "^[^_]*_", replacement = "", x = Samples)) %>%
  mutate(type = ifelse(type == "myeloid_1", "Myeloid_1", type)) %>%
  mutate(type = gsub(pattern = "\\_", replacement = "", x = type)) %>%
  mutate(type = gsub(pattern = "Myeloid", replacement = "M", x = type))

sample.order <- c("UC2", "UC4", "UC5", "UC7", "UC10", "UC11", "UC13", "UC14", "UC18", "UC19", "UC26", "UC34")

## Factor level
mSigAct_pd$group <- factor(x = mSigAct_pd$group, levels = sample.order)
mSigAct_pd$type <- factor(x = mSigAct_pd$type, 
                        levels = c("B1", "B2", "B5", "T1", "T2", "T3", "T4", "T4b", "T6", "T7", "NK1", "NK2", "NK3", 
                                   "M1", "M2"))
mSigAct_pd$signatures <- factor(x = mSigAct_pd$signatures, 
                                levels = c("SBS1",  "SBS5", "SBS22a", "SBS36", "SBS45", "SBS95"))

## pch according to batch
mSigAct_pd$batchPch<-NA
mSigAct_pd$batchPch[grep("UC4_|UC5_|UC7_|UC14_T-cell_4",mSigAct_pd$Samples)]<- "Batch1"
mSigAct_pd$batchPch[grepl("UC14_",mSigAct_pd$Samples) & !mSigAct_pd$Samples == "UC14_T-cell_4"]<- "Batch2"
mSigAct_pd$batchPch[grep("UC18_|UC34_",mSigAct_pd$Samples)]<- "Batch3"

## Relabel celltype column
mSigAct_pd <- mSigAct_pd %>% mutate(celltype = case_when(grepl("T", type) ~ "T-cell",
                                                         grepl("B", type) ~ "B-cell",
                                                         grepl("NK", type) ~ "NK-cell",
                                                         grepl("M", type) ~ "Myeloid"))

## Factor order some more
mSigAct_pd$celltype <- factor(x = mSigAct_pd$celltype, levels = c("B-cell", "T-cell", "NK-cell", "Myeloid"))

## Shape annotation
batch_anno <- c(2, 8, 20)
names(batch_anno) <- c("Batch1", "Batch2", "Batch3")
## Color annotation
type_anno <- c("blue","darkgreen","orange","purple")
names(type_anno) <- c("B-cell", "NK-cell", "T-cell", "Myeloid")

p3 <- ggplot(mSigAct_pd, aes(x = signatures, y = value)) +
  geom_quasirandom(aes(shape = batchPch, color = celltype), size = 1, width = 0.1) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = batch_anno, name = "Batch") +
  scale_color_manual(values = type_anno, name = "Cell Type") +
  ylab("Signature Attribution") + xlab("scWGS") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 6),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 5),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        legend.box.margin = margin(0, -5, 0, -5))
```

Panel C Forest plot (Analysis and code adapted from Sanskruti)
```{r}
glm_results <- read.csv(
  "/home/sanskruti/R/aa_exposure_/SBS22a_GLM_forest_plot_results.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Remove intercept
forest_df <- glm_results[
  glm_results$term != "Intercept",
]

# ---------------------------------------------------
# Create clean labels
# ---------------------------------------------------

forest_df$label <- as.character(
  forest_df$term
)

# Extract cell-type names from model terms
cell_type_rows <- grepl(
  "^C\\(type",
  forest_df$term
)

forest_df$label[
  cell_type_rows
] <- sub(
  "^.*\\[T\\.(.*)\\]$",
  "\\1",
  forest_df$term[
    cell_type_rows
  ]
)

# Rename sequencing-method term
sequencing_rows <- grepl(
  "Sequencing_method",
  forest_df$term
)

forest_df$label[
  sequencing_rows
] <- paste(
  "Sequencing",
  "method",
  sep = "\n"
)

# Rename total mutational burden
forest_df$label[
  forest_df$term == "log_totalMut"
] <- "Total mutational burden"

# Replace remaining underscores with spaces
forest_df$label <- gsub(
  "_",
  " ",
  forest_df$label
)

# Convert to factor only after all label edits are complete
forest_df$label <- factor(
  forest_df$label,
  levels = rev(
    unique(forest_df$label)
  )
)

# ---------------------------------------------------
# Statistical significance
# ---------------------------------------------------

forest_df$significance <- ifelse(
  forest_df$p_value < 0.05,
  "Significant",
  "Not significant"
)

# Significance stars
forest_df$stars <- ifelse(
  forest_df$p_value < 0.001,
  "***",
  ifelse(
    forest_df$p_value < 0.01,
    "**",
    ifelse(
      forest_df$p_value < 0.05,
      "*",
      ""
    )
  )
)

# Arrange terms in current dataframe order
forest_df$label <- factor(
  forest_df$label,
  levels = rev(
    unique(forest_df$label)
  )
)

forest_plot <- ggplot(
  forest_df,
  aes(
    x = IRR,
    y = label
  )
) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5,
    color = "gray40"
  ) +
  
  # Confidence intervals
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(
      xmin = IRR_ci_lower,
      xmax = IRR_ci_upper,
      color = significance
    ),
    height = 0.1,
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  
  # Point estimates
  geom_point(
    aes(
      fill = significance,
      color = significance
    ),
    shape = 21,
    size = 1,
    stroke = 0.9
  ) +
  
  # Significance stars above points
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = stars,
      color = significance
    ),
    position = position_nudge(
      y = 0.15
    ),
    size = 3,
    fontface = "bold",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Significant" = "red",
      "Not significant" = "black"
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Significant" = "red",
      "Not significant" = "white"
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = c(
      0.000000001,
      0.000001,
      0.001,
      1,
      2,
      4,
      10,
      30
    ),
    
    labels = c(
      "0.000000001",
      "0.000001",
      "0.001",
      "1",
      "2",
      "4",
      "10",
      "30"
    )
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Incidence rate ratio (95% CI)",
    y = NULL,
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  
  # Equivalent to Seaborn white-grid styling
  theme_bw(
    base_size = 13
  ) +
  
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 6,
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 6,
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 8
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    
    panel.grid.major = element_line(
      color = "gray88",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    
    legend.position = "none",
    
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 0,
      r = 0,
      b = 0,
      l = 0
    )
  )
```

Panel B: Complement scWGS with DS
```{r}
## scWGS data; keep only sbs22a attribution
scWGS_sbs22 <- mSigAct_pd %>% dplyr::filter(signatures == "SBS22a")

## DS data; process and keep sbs22a attribution
load("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/mSigAct/cleanedsbs31uc14_dsBloodFraction_cosmic_mSigAct.rda") ## UC14 was cleaned using SR
ds_sbs22 <- sparseAssign$proposed.assignment %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  sweep(1, rowSums(.), "/") %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .))) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Samples") %>% 
  gather(data = ., key = "signatures", value = "value", -Samples) %>%
  mutate(group = paste0("UC", as.numeric(str_extract(Samples, "\\d+"))),
         type = case_when(grepl(pattern = "T-cell", x = Samples) ~ "T-cell",
                          grepl(pattern = "B-cell", x = Samples) ~ "B-cell",
                          grepl(pattern = "NK-cell", x = Samples) ~ "NK-cell",
                          grepl(pattern = "Myeloid", x = Samples) ~ "Myeloid")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(signatures == "SBS22a")

## Factor order
ds_sbs22$group <- factor(x = ds_sbs22$group, levels = c("UC4", "UC5", "UC7", "UC14"))
ds_sbs22$status <- ifelse(ds_sbs22$group == "UC5", "Negative", "Positive")

## color annotation
color_anno <- c("#803E75", "#FF6800", "#A6BDD7", "#C10020", "#CEA262", "#007D34", "#00538A")
names(color_anno) <- c("UC7", "UC14", "UC18", "UC19", "UC34", "UC4", "UC5")

## shape annotation
shape_anno <- c(5,6)
names(shape_anno) <- c("Positive", "Negative")

p4 <- ggplot(data = scWGS_sbs22, aes(x = celltype, y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA,   fill = "grey85", color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_quasirandom(width = 0.18, size = 1, color = "grey70", alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_point(data = ds_sbs22, aes(x = type, y = value, color = group, shape = status),
    size = 1,
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.12)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_anno, name = "Patient") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = shape_anno, name = "SBS22a\nby WGS") +
  ylab("SBS22a Attribution") + xlab("DS") +
  theme_bw() +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(order = 1),
         color = guide_legend(order = 2)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 6),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 5),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        legend.box.margin = margin(0, -5, 0, -5))
```
